notes.title: Announcement of a new game and trading cards.
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989576/70cd433a4cae40cdd1d467699cdcf19454951e33.png[/img]Hello! Our new game [b]Hentai Two GIrls[/b] is coming out very soon. Add it to your wish list to find out about the release date as soon as possible. Also, collection cards were made, which will be published as soon as permission is obtained. Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
